watches.name: Air Captain - Cove (Blue Guilloche)
watches.description: Air Blue is back. And it started with a watch we couldn’t stop looking at. We were meeting with Bernhardt about doing something together with Deep Blue when they brought out the Captain. Beautiful guilloché dials. A slim profile. A high-beat Miyota movement. And on one version, heat-blued hands that caught our attention immediately. They showed it to us on leather. We kept imagining it on a NATO -style strap. Still elegant, just more relaxed. The kind of watch we’d put on in the morning without thinking about where the day might take us. You know us for dive watches. The Captain was taking us somewhere different. Then it clicked. Air Blue. Here was a chance to bring the Air Blue line back, work with another American watch company, and offer our Deep Blue collectors something unexpected. Introducing the Air Captain. We’ve paired Bernhardt’s Captain with an Air Blue N UTO strap. It’s Deep Blue X Bernhardt . Bernhardt on the dial. Air Blue on the strap. The details that first drew us to the Captain, with a different feel on the wrist. For us, that’s what makes this worth doing. We get to reintroduce the Air Blue line through a watch we’re excited to wear—and give you a reason to make room for something unexpected . Three colorways: • Cove — a deep blue. • Fog — steel white with heat-blued hands. • Nocturne — midnight-dark purple. A limited release. Specifications Case: 38mm diameter | 9.55mm thickness | 45mm lug-to-lug | 20mm lug width | Stainless steel | Fully polished case, bezel, and crown Movement: Miyota 9039 Automatic | 28,800 BPH | Automatic winding | Hacking seconds | Regulated in-house Crystal & Caseback: Sapphire crystal | Engraved caseback with classic Bernhardt Captain icon Dial & Hands: Guilloché dial | Applied numerals | Heat-anodized blue hands Water Resistance: 5 ATM / 50 Meters Strap: Black NUTO strap, Air Blue Logo Assembled in the USA

watches.name: DepthMaster 2000 Precision Diver (White to Grey Textured Gradient)
watches.description: White fades into grey across a richly textured dial, giving the DepthMaster 2000 a sense of depth before it ever touches the water. A black dive bezel frames the shifting tones, while an orange minute hand cuts across the dial—a vivid flash of color against the cool, understated backdrop. That striking face belongs to a serious diver. Rated to 2,000 meters, the DepthMaster pairs helium-safe capability with ultra-bright lume and the dependable Miyota 9015 automatic movement. Its 42mm stainless steel case flows into a custom solid-link bracelet, bringing strength and substance to a watch whose details reward a closer look. Built for the depths. Compelling at the surface. watches.description: Lomax Diver: Grey Dial, Unitimer Bezel, with Steel Coffin-Link Bracelet (& Transparent Silicone Strap) Recognized by industry insiders, including HODINKEE: "I'd wear this watch all the time." We set out to build the diver we actually wanted to wear. A true 38mm case: compact, balanced, and sculpted to sit just right. A 120-click unidirectional bezel with real presence. watches.name: Binnacle Diver - Atlantic Swell
watches.description: The Binnacle Diver returns as a refined, professional-grade dive watch. The 41mm stainless steel case delivers 300 meters of water resistance in a slim 11mm profile , balancing serious capability with everyday wearability. Assembled in the USA and powered by the Miyota 9039 automatic movement, each watch is regulated in-house to ±5 seconds per day . A dimensional sandwich dial with Grade A Super-LumiNova BGW9 and a redesigned bracelet with on-the-go micro-adjustment complete this modern evolution of a Bernhardt classic.

watches.name: Binnacle Timer - Green
watches.description: The Binnacle Timer seamlessly blends the timeless heritage of cushion-case dive watches with fresh, modern design elements. Breaking new ground, its bidirectional internal bezel is a pioneering feature, incorporating both chronological and inverse numerals for effortless time tracking in both elapsed and countdown modes. Enhanced visibility in low-light conditions is ensured with C1 Super-LumiNova throughout the dial, hands, and bezel. With a water resistance rating of 660 feet, this robust case is coupled with a closed case back, featuring an hourglass emblem symbolizing the precision timing capabilities of this innovative model.
